name: Kon Tum Prison
kicker: French-era prison museum in the centre
summary: French-era cells in the centre, about an hour and a half on the Go Vietnam cluster page. Go Vietnam prints 30,000 VND. The Kon Tum provincial portal does not print that fee. Confirm it at the gate. Skip it if you wanted a light scenic walk.
fee: 30,000 VND on Go Vietnam; check on arrival
heroCaption: The courtyard and memorial in front of the hall
gettingThere: The prison museum is in the city centre, in the same cluster as the wooden church. Walk from there. Go Vietnam is the source for that cluster. Minutes from a named hotel are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From central Kon Tum
legs.body: Walk. The Go Vietnam cluster page puts the prison in the centre with the church. No source prints the minutes. Those minutes are check on arrival.

admissionNote: Go Vietnam prints 30,000 VND and about ninety minutes. The Kon Tum provincial portal does not print a matching fee. Confirm the ticket at the gate. No child price, inclusion, or extra is printed.

links.label: Go Vietnam cluster page
links.note: 30,000 VND and about ninety minutes. No clock is printed.
